messages:
sarah_cs: Folks, Northbridge onboarding week 2 update: account health dropped from 9 -> 7 after last-week timeouts. Renewal in ~11 weeks. Proposing a recurring enablement pattern: weekly 30m office hours for quick triage + biweekly 60m technical workshops. Thoughts?

mike_success: I support the pattern. Weekly 30m quick fixes, biweekly 60m for configuration and demos. Call the workshops 'integration deep-dive'.

anna_enable: 60m workshop agenda suggestion: 10m kick-off & goals, 20m config deep-dive (routing, batching), 20m hands-on runbook, 10m action items and follow-ups. I can own slides and workshop facilitation. :white_check_mark:

james_se: SRE asks for a short preflight checklist before any Dedicated migration talk. Recommend we send a 5-min prework: sample logs, current request patterns, and their active service config. I can draft the snippet and a `curl` test.

olivia_csm: Important: PM blamed the timeouts for internal pushback. If we don't demonstrate measurable latency/cost wins, renewal could become a tougher conversation. Recommend a PM 1:1 this week to align expectations and scope.

sarah_cs: Olivia can you run the 1:1? I'll schedule the recurring invites once we confirm a slot. Proposed office hours slots for polling: Tue 10:00-10:30 PT, Wed 16:00-16:30 PT, Thu 08:00-08:30 PT. Which works?

olivia_csm: I can do Tue 10:00 PT. I'll confirm with their PM and report back.

anna_enable: If Tue 10:00 PT is confirmed I'll create recurring invites and attach the draft agenda. Draft deck link (internal): https://drive.redwood.example/northbridge/enable-v1

mike_success: For the weekly troubleshooting to be useful, let's require 10m of prework from the customer's SRE: zipped latency logs + active config file.

james_se: I'll add this curl example for latency capture to the prework doc: ```bash
curl -sS -w "time_total:%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"input":"ping"}'
```

sarah_cs: Nice. After the first two sessions we'll run a two-question feedback form: "Did this session unblock you?" and "Top remaining blocker?" If feedback shows >3 blockers or falling satisfaction, escalate to exec sponsor.

deploy-bot: calendar-bot: will send invites once slot is confirmed and attendees list present.

olivia_csm: PM confirmed Tue 10:00 PT. They asked that the first deep-dive include routing fallbacks and cost controls.

anna_enable: Adding routing fallbacks, cost-control patterns, and James' runbook to the workshop deck. I'll distribute prework checklist by EOD and include a short template for logs. :rocket:

sarah_cs: Action items: Olivia = PM 1:1 this week; Anna = schedule invites + deck + prework; James = runbook + curl snippet; Mike = perf experiment plan for batching and token-cost comparison. Aim for measurable perf/cost improvements within 3 weeks to influence renewal.

mike_success: I'll prepare A/B plan and sample dashboards to show token-per-response before/after.

olivia_csm: I'll update the account health tracker after the PM 1:1 and surface any negotiation flags.

sarah_cs: Thanks team. Closing when invites are out. :slightly_smiling_face:
